mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ (anaa tilmiidha) means: I am a pupil (girl).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) means bag.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Water is useful (good for you)."
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ mean?
options: The friends are at the party.
Above the table there is a balloon.
On the table there is a cake.
mcq.explanation: الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ (al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla) means: The friends are at the party.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ (marhaban yaa Ahmad) means: Hello, Ahmad.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I see with my eye."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

mcq.q: Which mark gives the short vowel 'a'?
options: kasra, a small line below the letter
Damma, a small curl above the letter
fatHa, a small slanted line above the letter
mcq.explanation: fatHa is the mark for the short vowel a.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَمْسٌ (shams) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

mcq.q: What does the ending -ii mean in abii and ummii?
mcq.explanation: The ending -ii means 'my', so abii is 'my father' and ummii is 'my mother'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I eat bread."
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ل?
mcq.explanation: The letter ل is called laam.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ر?
mcq.explanation: The letter ر is called raa.

mcq.q: Which phrase would you say to a friend on a birthday?
mcq.explanation: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid means 'Happy birthday'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother's brother"?
mcq.explanation: خَالٌ (khaal) means mother's brother.

mcq.q: Which of these is unique about Arabic writing?
options: It is written from right to left
mcq.explanation: Arabic runs from right to left and has 28 letters and no capitals.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I am from Kenya."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clouds"?
mcq.explanation: سَحَابٌ (sahaab) means clouds.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) mean?
options: What is your name? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خَالَةٌ (khaala) mean?
mcq.explanation: خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter غ?
mcq.explanation: The letter غ is called ghayn.

mcq.q: How does rain help people?
options: It helps crops to grow and gives us water
mcq.explanation: Rain waters crops and fills rivers and tanks.

mcq.q: In the game Simon Says, how do learners show they are listening?
options: They act only on the correct instruction
mcq.explanation: The game trains careful listening to instructions.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ is read hadiyya and means gift.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic question mark ؟ tell the reader?
options: The voice rises at the end
mcq.explanation: A question ends with a rising voice.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ أُمِّي (haadhihi ummii) means: This is my mother.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَاءٌ (maa') mean?
mcq.explanation: مَاءٌ (maa') means water.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَخٌ (akh) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَخٌ (akh) means brother.

mcq.q: Which word means 'I drink'?
mcq.explanation: ashrabu means I drink. aakulu means I eat and uhibbu means I like.

mcq.q: What is a good way to give peer feedback on reading?
options: Say what went well and give one tip to improve
mcq.explanation: Feedback should be honest and kind.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ يَدِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ع?
mcq.explanation: The letter ع is called ʿayn.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ج?
mcq.explanation: The letter ج is called jiim.

mcq.q: Which reason best explains why we greet one another?
options: It is only needed at school
It is only needed by adults
It is only needed when we meet strangers
It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
mcq.explanation: A greeting is for everyone. It shows that we see and respect the other person.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كِتَابٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كِتَابٌ is read kitaab and means book.

mcq.q: What does al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana mean?
options: The lamp is above the table.
The pen is in the bag.
The key is in the cupboard.
The chair is at the door.
mcq.explanation: miftaah is key and khizaana is cupboard.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ mean?
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

mcq.q: Which Arabic instruction means 'sit down'?
mcq.explanation: ijlis means sit down. qif means stand up.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "school"?
mcq.explanation: مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَلْوَى (halwaa) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَلْوَى (halwaa) means sweets.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother's sister"?
mcq.explanation: خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "room"?
mcq.explanation: غُرْفَةٌ (ghurfa) means room.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ is read aghliqi l-baab and means close the door.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَوْزٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَوْزٌ is read mawz and means bananas.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I write with my hand."
mcq.explanation: أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ mean?
mcq.explanation: نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "In the kitchen there is a table."
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

mcq.q: Which ending shows that you are speaking to a boy?
mcq.explanation: The ending -ka is used when speaking to a boy or man, as in kayfa haaluka?

mcq.q: A girl asks another girl maa ismuki? What is she asking?
mcq.explanation: maa ismuki? asks a girl for her name. The ending -ki is used for a girl.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "delicious"?
mcq.explanation: لَذِيذٌ (ladhiidh) means delicious.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ي?
mcq.explanation: The letter ي is called yaa.

mcq.q: What can help a nervous speaker?
mcq.explanation: Practice makes a speaker calm and confident.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) mean?
mcq.explanation: جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) means new.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The lamp is above the table."
mcq.explanation: الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "eggs"?
mcq.explanation: بَيْضٌ (bayd) means eggs.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word لِسَانٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: لِسَانٌ is read lisaan and means tongue.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Saturday"?
mcq.explanation: السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

mcq.q: Which is good body language for a speaker?
options: Standing straight and looking at the audience
mcq.explanation: Eye contact and a steady stance help the audience to listen.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) mean?
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) means gift.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The banana is delicious."
mcq.explanation: الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Who is this? (a boy or man)"
mcq.explanation: مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "salt"?
mcq.explanation: مِلْحٌ (milh) means salt.

mcq.q: When you time a friend reading, what matters most?
mcq.explanation: Timing helps pace, but accuracy and smoothness matter most.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ (anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ) means: I am in Grade 4.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ is read aghmiD ʿaynayka and means close your eyes.

mcq.q: What is a thematic word?
options: A word that belongs to the theme of a text
mcq.explanation: Thematic words belong to the main topic of a text.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is rain."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I smell with my nose."
mcq.explanation: أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لَ?
mcq.explanation: لَ is read la.

mcq.q: What is a reader's theatre?
options: A group reads a script aloud with expression
mcq.explanation: In a reader's theatre learners read a script aloud, using their voices to act.

mcq.q: What is a good way to give feedback on someone's handwriting?
options: Say something good first, then give one tip
mcq.explanation: Kind and helpful feedback encourages a friend to improve.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Today is Thursday."
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter د?
mcq.explanation: The letter د is called daal.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عَصِيرٌ is read ʿasiir and means juice.

mcq.q: What is rhyme?
options: Words or lines that end with the same sound
mcq.explanation: Rhyme is when words or lines end with the same sound.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "ear"?
mcq.explanation: أُذُنٌ (udhun) means ear.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لَا?
mcq.explanation: لَا is read laa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean?
options: The chair is at the door.
The key is in the cupboard.
Do not play with the knife.
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "and upon you peace (the reply)"?
mcq.explanation: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ (wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam) means and upon you peace (the reply).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
In the room there is a bed.
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Above the table there is a balloon."
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بَ?
mcq.explanation: بَ is read ba.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) mean?
mcq.explanation: أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) means week.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sun"?
mcq.explanation: شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I drink milk'?
mcq.explanation: ashrabu means I drink and haliib means milk.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "book"?
mcq.explanation: كِتَابٌ (kitaab) means book.

mcq.q: What does nahnu narqusu mean?
mcq.explanation: nahnu means we and narqusu means we dance.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "fish"?
mcq.explanation: سَمَكٌ (samak) means fish.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ت make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter ت makes the sound t as in tap.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "in"?
mcq.explanation: فِي (fii) means in.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) means kitchen.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَايٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَايٌ is read shaay and means tea.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "face"?
mcq.explanation: وَجْهٌ (wajh) means face.

mcq.q: What goes on the back of a vocabulary flashcard?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic word is on the front. The back shows the sound and the meaning.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter م make?
mcq.explanation: The letter م makes the sound m as in mat.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَمْسِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَمْسِ is read amsi and means yesterday.
